en.headline: Plain cigarette packs gazetted, in force from March 2027
en.dek: Standard brown packaging, new graphic warnings and digital duty stamps will apply after a nine-month transition, the Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office said.
body: The government gazetted rules on Friday requiring conventional smoking products sold in Hong Kong to use standardised packaging from 1 March 2027, with a nine-month transition before full enforcement on 1 December 2027. Packs will have to drop brand logos and decorative design, use a uniform dark-brown colour, and display brand and variant names only in a prescribed font, size and position.

Manny Lam Man-chung, head of the Department of Health’s Tobacco and Alcohol Control Office, said tar and nicotine figures will also be removed from packs. He said those machine-test numbers do not reflect what a smoker actually inhales and have no safe level, and that listing them can be used to imply a product is less harmful. Twelve graphic health warnings in use since 2018 will be replaced with new images and wording, and each duty-paid pack will need a digital anti-counterfeit stamp.

Lam said pack-size limits proposed earlier had been relaxed after consultation with the trade and lawmakers, so that most cigarettes now on sale can fit the new dimensions. He described the packaging rules as one of 10 tobacco-control measures announced in 2024 and said a ban on flavoured cigarettes would follow. During the transition, older stock and new-specification packs may appear side by side; from 1 December 2027, selling a non-compliant pack will carry a maximum fine of HK$50,000.

zh.headline: 統一煙包設計今日刊憲 明年3月起分階段實施
zh.dek: 傳統煙包須改暗吮色及指定字體，取消焦油尼古丁標示，並更新圖像忠告及加貼完稅防偽標籤，12月全面實施。
body: 政府周五刊憲，規定傳統吸煙產品由2027年3月1日起採用統一包裝，設9個月過渡期，同年12月1日全面實施。煙包須去掉品牌標誌及裝飾設計，其餘位置統一用暗吮色，品牌及產品型號名稱只能按指定字體、大小、顏色及位置印出。
衞生署控煙酒辦公室主任林民聰表示，煙包上的焦油及尼古丁數值亦會取消。他指有關數字一般只經機器檢測，不能反映實際吸入量，而這些物質並無安全值，標示或被用來暗示危害較低。自2018年起沿用的12款圖像健康忠告將更新圖案及文字，每包已完稅煙亦須附有數碼防偽標籤，以分辨私煙。
林民聰說，較早建議的煙包尺寸限制經諮詢業界及議員後已放寬，市面上大部分產品可符合新規。他指今次規定屬2024年控煙十招之一，其後仍會推禁止加味煙等措施。過渡期內新舊包裝可並存；12月1日起售賣不合規煙包，最高可罰款5萬元。
